UPSTREAM: vboot: remove OPROM-related code As of CL:1605641, vboot2 code should be used for setting and checking display init state. Remove all vboot1 OPROM-related code, and use the vboot2 display init code which has already been added in previous commits. coreboot should not be reading vboot NVRAM flags directly. Remove the function vboot_wants_oprom(), and instead rely on display_init_required(), which uses the VBOOT_WD_FLAG_DISPLAY_INIT value stored in vboot_working_data.flags, initialized during verstage. Note that this means in the case of CONFIG_VBOOT=y, the return value of display_init_required() can only be trusted after verstage has been executed. This should not be a problem assuming that all display initialization occurs in ramstage. shill: connection: Use per-device tables for all connections This change causes Connection to use a per-device table for all connections, and sets up routing rules such that the routing behavior complies with Shill's priority rules. In particular, VPNs must be used when applicable, and priorities of physical interfaces should follow Shill's Service sorting order. This implementation, as with the previous routing setup, does not adequately handle the case where two distinct interfaces have the same subnet. Future changes that allow for socket marking and routing based on packet marks will be needed to resolve this issue. Note that there is an existing issue (crbug.com/938629) where a non-default physical interface is used for all v4 or v6 traffic when the default physical interface does not have connectivity for that IP version. This CL does not change the existing behavior with respect to that issue. BACKPORT: FROMLIST: tpm: Fix TPM 1.2 Shutdown sequence to prevent future TPM operations TPM 2.0 Shutdown involve sending TPM2_Shutdown to TPM chip and disabling future TPM operations.
